如果已有方垫形、椭圆或祖母绿形目标，从预设库找接近的轮廓通常更直接。把预设当成研: If you already want a cushion, oval or emerald shape, find a similar outline in the library. Treat the preset as a study: retain its author and source, and save your own variation separately.

顶视看轮廓和台面，正视看冠高与亭深，底视看亭部组织，轴测看整体。: Top shows outline and table; front shows crown height and pavilion depth; bottom shows pavilion structure; axonometric shows the whole shape.
轮廓适合你的镶嵌方向吗？台面大小与外形的性格一致吗？暂时不满意的部分，应当能说成: Does the outline suit the intended setting? Does the table size suit the shape’s character? Describe any remaining concern as one concrete change.
在工作台上找到你的下一步: Find your next action in the workbench
中间看 3D 造型，左侧调当前切割，右侧上方查看设计步骤、下方同时看两个方向。C: Inspect the 3D shape in the center, adjust the current cut on the left, and review steps and two live views on the right. Each CUT STACK row is a group of facets edited together.

行业角管倾斜，深度管推进，分度管朝向；重复和镜像组织一圈刻面的节奏。: Faceting angle controls tilt, depth controls advance, and index controls direction. Repeats and mirrors arrange facets around the stone.
C 冠部、G 腰部、P 亭部切换列表，工序多时滚动查看。点击行内“编辑”进入；区: Use C Crown, G Girdle and P Pavilion to filter the list; scroll for more cuts. Click Edit on a row. The green New control below the region tabs becomes the new-cut status bar. Save / Discard appear in the edited row.

Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, Shift-drag to pan. GitHub remains available in every mode and opens in a new tab.
一边试形，一边核对冠亭和侧面: Check crown, pavilion and profile as you work
设计师需要同时判断面群节奏与整体高度。右侧两个正交窗口跟随中央当前造型，让你在转: Judge facet rhythm and overall height together. Two orthographic windows follow the current shape while keeping fixed viewing directions as you rotate the central 3D view.
上窗可切冠部顶视／亭部底视，下窗固定侧视；预览不显示机械臂，便于看清真实交线。: The upper window switches between crown/top and pavilion/bottom; the lower window stays in side view. Helpers are hidden so the actual intersections remain clear.
从预设库载入 Eight Main Highlight，编辑 C1 冠部；稍微调: Load Eight Main Highlight and edit C1 Crown. Adjust depth slightly and watch the central and side views update together.
上窗选“冠部”查看台面周围的刻面分配，选“亭部”检查底部交线。切换只影响这个小窗: Choose Crown in the upper window to inspect facets around the table, or Pavilion for bottom intersections. This affects only that window, without rotating the central stone or changing cuts.
下窗从侧面看冠高、腰部和亭深。注意台面位置、轮廓衔接与新增小面；满意后在 CUT: Use the lower window to compare crown height, girdle and pavilion depth. Check table position, outline continuity and new small facets. Save in CUT STACK if satisfied; otherwise discard.
在保持同一观察方向时，新增刻面让节奏更清楚了吗？侧面比例是否仍接近原来的设计目标: At the same viewing angle, does the added facet group make the rhythm clearer? Does the profile still match your design goal?
小窗是实时只读观察：浅蓝为新建预览、淡粉为编辑层；未保存造型可比较，但不写入项目: Side windows are live, read-only views: pale blue marks a new preview and pale pink the edited tier. Unsaved shapes can be compared but are excluded from projects and exports.
我想改这组刻面：直接点“编辑”: To change a facet group, click Edit
不必猜面数是不是按钮。每个可编辑图层都有明确的“编辑”入口；选中的行会显示“编辑: Every editable tier has a visible Edit control. The selected row says Editing. Clicking the name still renames the tier.
当前图层 · 放弃或保存: Bottom of list · Discard or save
当前 C1 处于编辑中。放弃与保存位于当前图层行内。: C1 is being edited. Discard and Save are in the current layer row.
在 C 冠部列表找到 C1 冠部主面，点击“编辑”。刚进入时，宝石仍是保存的形状: Find C1 Crown mains in the C Crown list and click Edit. The initial view matches the saved shape.
把角度稍微改大，转到正视看看主面如何倾斜。粉色是当前编辑反馈，不是最终材质。: Increase the angle slightly and use front view to inspect the tilt. Pink indicates the current edit, not the final material.
满意则保存；想保留原方案则放弃。保存后回到空闲状态；撤销可以回到上一步。: Save the change if it works, or discard to retain the original. Saving returns to idle; Undo restores the previous step.
能否一眼看出自己编辑的是哪组面？改动是否更接近你刚写下的目标？不要只以“可以点击: Can you immediately tell which facets you are editing? Does the change support your stated goal? Being able to click Save is not the design outcome.
用角度、深度和朝向做小幅探索: Explore angle, depth and direction in small steps
一次只改变一类关系，更容易知道变化来自哪里。先看几何，再看材质；浅蓝新建预览、淡: Change one relationship at a time so you can identify its effect. Look at geometry before material. Blue new-cut previews and pink edit highlights are interaction feedback only.
新建 CUT 时，操纵杆与主切面帮助你理解当前方向；实际刻出的面由实体交线决定。: The helper and primary plane show the direction of a new CUT. Actual facets are determined by intersections with the solid.
对冠部或亭部以 0.01° 为最小步进精调。台面固定 0°、腰部固定 90°。单: Crown and pavilion angles adjust in 0.01° steps. The table stays at 0°, the girdle at 90°. Single Meet allows angle changes; dual Meet determines the angle from two points.
深度：决定推进到哪里: Depth: decide how far to advance
沿法线推进切面，会改变与周围刻面的交线。可以精确输入；不要把屏幕上杆端的圆点当作: Advancing the cutting plane along its normal changes intersections with neighboring facets. Enter exact values when needed. The handle endpoint is not a gemstone vertex.
比较一颗挺拔的冠部与更平缓的冠部: Compare a tall crown with a lower crown
目标：保持圆形轮廓，比较更平缓的冠部能否适合你的镶嵌高度或整体风格。整体比例会连: Goal: keep the round outline and see whether a lower crown suits your setting height or style. The group transform includes the table, helping retain continuity between tiers.
同一正视方向下比较；本例只改冠部高度比例，亭部不变。: Compare from the same front view. Only crown height changes; the pavilion stays unchanged.
导入 01-round-start.json，在冠部列表点击“整体变换”。: Import 01-round-start.json and click Group transform in the crown list.
高度比例输入 70%，其余位移与旋转保持 0。查看正视和侧视，满意再保存。可导入: Set height scale to 70%, leaving translation and rotation at 0. Inspect front and side views, then save. Import 05-low-crown.json to compare the result.
看台面与冠部过渡是否仍清楚，以及高低关系是否适合你的方案。70% 只是对比条件，: Check the table-to-crown transition and whether the height suits your design. 70% is a comparison condition, not a universal optimum.
让主切面准确经过一个已有交点: Pass the primary plane through an existing intersection
案例 B · Jump 与单 Meet: EXAMPLE B · JUMP AND SINGLE MEET
目标：让新面准确会合到已有结构，减少凭眼对齐的反复试探。Jump 是“带你去候选: Goal: meet an existing structure precisely. Jump browses candidate positions; Meet remembers a chosen position as a constraint.
锁定 A 后，深度由目标点决定；行业角仍可用于探索面的倾斜。: After locking A, the target point determines depth; faceting angle remains adjustable.
新建冠部切割，使用“下一交点／上一交点”浏览，或点击“选择顶点”后在实体上选点。: Create a crown cut and use Next / Previous intersection, or Select vertex and pick a point on the solid. Check that the highlighted sources are the intended intersection.
确认预览后点击“锁定 Meet A”。此后调整角度时，主切面仍通过 A，深度自动: Click Lock Meet A after inspecting the preview. When you change angle, depth adjusts to keep the primary plane passing through A.
重复面会一起切割，但约束针对主面。旋转宝石检查其它方向，满足造型意图再加入序列。: Repeated facets cut together, but the constraint applies to the primary facet. Rotate the stone and check other directions before adding the cut.
本页演示在完整圆形练习上新建冠部的单点动作；后续棱面案例继续使用这份起点。腰部与: This example adds a single-point crown cut to the round exercise. Later edge examples use the same starting point. Girdle and fixed table cuts do not support Meet / Jump.
在已有棱上，决定新装饰面的起点: Choose where decoration starts on an existing edge
目标：在八瓣冠部之间增加一组小面，让交线从“主面之间的尖棱”变成有宽窄变化的装饰: Goal: add small facets between eight crown mains, turning sharp ridges into a decorative band of varying width. An edge ratio gives you a repeatable position to compare.
方案 02：I6 主面、8 折、50°，通过 C1 的 I96 与 I12 之间: Variant 02: primary I6, 8 repeats, 50°, passing through one third of the sloping edge between C1’s I96 and I12 facets.
导入 02-edge-third.json，点击 C2 的“编辑”。A 来源说明: Import 02-edge-third.json and edit C2. The A source description and canvas marker identify the sloping edge, not a horizontal table edge.
导入 01，新增冠部，分度设 6、重复 8、角度 50°。选这条斜棱，沿棱比例设: Import 01, add a crown cut, and set index 6, repeat 8 and angle 50°. Select the sloping edge, set its ratio to 1/3, then lock A.
本例稳定方向从靠腰端到靠台面端，1/3 较靠腰端。其他棱可临时把 t 设为 0、: Here the stable edge direction runs from girdle toward table, so 1/3 is nearer the girdle. For another edge, temporarily try t = 0 and 1 to identify its ends. Do not assume every edge runs upward.
棱 Meet 让切面通过棱上的一个点，不是要求整条棱落在切面上。若选错棱，重新选: An edge Meet passes the plane through one point on an edge; it does not place the whole edge in the plane. If you chose the wrong edge, select the correct source instead of compensating with depth.
同一条棱，两个比例，两种节奏: One edge, two ratios, two rhythms
保持 50°、I6 和 8 折不变，只把 A 从斜棱 1/3 移到 2/3。这样: Keep 50°, I6 and 8 repeats unchanged; move A from 1/3 to 2/3 of the same edge. This isolates how much crown area the decoration occupies.
两份文件都保留 57 个有效面。面数相同，不代表面的宽度与台面周边的留白相同。: Both files retain 57 effective facets. Equal facet counts do not imply equal facet widths or equal space around the table.
导入 02，编辑 C2，先在 A 行点击“解除”，再选择同一条斜棱并设为 2/3: Import 02, edit C2, release A, then select the same sloping edge at 2/3. Lock Meet A and save. You can also import 03 directly. A locked Meet is not adjusted by freely dragging depth.
看新面靠近台面的端部、主冠面的剩余面积，以及顶视中八次重复形成的节奏。再转轴测确: Look at the new facet tips near the table, the remaining crown-main area and the eightfold rhythm in top view. Check axonometric view to rule out a viewpoint illusion.
你希望主冠面更完整，还是希望细分更明显？为两个方案各写一句适用理由，再选一个继续: Do you want broader crown mains or more subdivision? Write a reason to use each alternative before choosing. This manual does not declare one more beautiful.
一个点不够时，用第二个点确定倾斜: Use a second point to determine tilt
目标：同时照顾两处会合关系。在主分度已经确定的情况下，两个不同的点可以共同确定切: Goal: satisfy two meeting relationships at once. With a fixed primary index, two distinct points can determine the plane’s tilt and position together.
方案 04：A 为斜棱 1/3，B 为已有顶点；本例求得约 50.50°，深度一: Variant 04: A is at one third of the sloping edge, B an existing vertex. The solved angle is about 50.50°; depth is solved with it.
导入 04-dual-meet.json，编辑 C2。分别观察 A/B 标记和来: Import 04-dual-meet.json and edit C2. Inspect both markers and sources to understand which intersections they preserve.
从已锁 A 的方案开始，使用“下一第二点／上一第二点”浏览 B，或显式选第二个顶: Starting with A locked, browse Next / Previous second point or select a second vertex or edge point. Inspect the candidate, then click Lock B · Dual Meet.
行业角和深度一起只读是正常行为。回到顶视与轴测，判断这两处会合是否值得牺牲原先偏: Angle and depth becoming read-only is expected. Use top and axonometric views to judge whether meeting both points is worth changing your preferred tilt.
第二点不一定存在合适解。不要把“两个点都选上了”当作造型更好的理由；双 Meet: A suitable second-point solution may not exist. Selecting two points does not make a design better by itself; dual Meet is a precision construction tool.
想退一步，保留已经做好的选择: Step back while keeping the choice you made
探索新方向时，知道怎样退回同样重要。先分清“还在浏览第二点”和“已经锁定两个点”: When exploring, know how to return. Distinguish browsing a second point from having both points locked.
A/B 分开显示，便于解除一个来源；锁定的参数会明确禁用。: A and B are shown separately so either source can be released. Locked parameters are visibly disabled.
取消第二点预览，会回到原来的单 A 角度与深度。你不需要记住并重新输入旧数值。: Canceling the second-point preview restores the original single-A angle and depth. You do not need to remember or re-enter them.
解除 B：保留 A，重新自由调角度。解除 A：原 B 成为新的 A。清除全部：回: Release B to retain A and adjust angle again. Release A to promote B to A. Clear all to restore free angle and depth.
两点重合、主方向不合适或超出可达范围时，更换点或主分度。系统不会偷偷替你换另一个: If points coincide, the direction is unsuitable or the target is out of reach, change the point or primary index. The system does not silently choose another primary facet.
先关闭浮层或当前拾取／比例工具，再退出第二点预览，最后取消 CUT。留意当前状态: Close the floating panel or current picking / ratio tool first, then leave the second-point preview, then cancel the CUT. Watch the state rather than pressing repeatedly.
从八次重复，改成四个重点方向: From eight repeats to four main directions
目标：把装饰集中到四个方向，给构图留出主次。自定义索引可以指定哪些方向出现这一组: Goal: concentrate decoration in four directions to establish hierarchy. Custom indices specify where facets appear; the primary facet specifies the direction used for positioning.
方案 06 只保留 I6、30、54、78。少四个装饰面带来留白差异；并非减少全: Variant 06 retains only I6, 30, 54 and 78. Removing four decorative facets changes the open areas; it does not remove all crown facets.
导入 02-edge-third.json，编辑 C2，再切到自定义索引，输入: Import 02-edge-third.json, edit C2, switch to Custom indices and enter 6, 30, 54, 78.
在“主切面分度”中选 6，再检查 A 的会合关系。主面必须属于当前集合；不能删除: Select 6 as the Primary facet index, then check the A Meet. The primary facet must belong to the set; it cannot be removed while a constraint uses it.
用顶视判断四向强调与你预想的镶嵌方向是否协调。旋转朝向、改集合都应回到实体检查。: Use top view to check whether the four directions suit your intended setting. Recheck the solid after rotating or changing the index set.
本例仍为四向对称。真正不对称的集合也能表达，但需要你逐面检查，系统不会自动替你补: This example still has fourfold symmetry. Asymmetric sets are supported, but require facet-by-facet inspection; symmetry is not added automatically.
用重复、镜像与预形表达设计意图: Express intent with repeats, mirrors and preforms
一组面可以贡献连续节奏，也可以只是下一步的来源。给步骤起有意义的名称，比记住一长: A facet group may create rhythm or provide a source for a later cut. Meaningful step names make it easier to resume than remembering long parameter lists.
明确主切面后，操纵杆与 Meet / Jump 都围绕该方向工作。: The helper and Meet / Jump follow the selected primary facet.
重复：统一一圈的规则: Repeat: one rule around the stone
8 折会生成八个明确切面。之后新增切割可能覆盖部分旧面；旧工序仍保留，便于撤销和: 8 repeats generate eight explicit planes. Later cuts may cover some earlier facets; the original operations remain available for undo and redo.
镜像：增加另一组方向: Mirror: add a second set of directions
调整镜像轴偏移，会产生镜像成员；与原面重合时去重。看顶视中的交替节奏，不要只追求: Adjusting mirror-axis offset adds mirrored members; coincident planes are deduplicated. Observe the alternating rhythm in top view instead of maximizing facet count.
普通冠／亭层可标记“预形工序”，表示它在你的构思中作为后续步骤的基础。该标记不会: Mark a normal crown or pavilion tier as a Preform operation when it prepares for later steps. This marker does not hide, delete or disable the cut.

Click or drag the timeline to seek; Play supports 0.5× / 1× / 2×. Manual stepping and backgrounding pause playback. The right panel shows the next index, angle, depth and tier order. Each cut holds 0.5 s, then turns to a 45° offset view; the pink next-cut plane appears once settled. Transition speed is adjustable. Dragging pauses following; the switch resumes it. Completed counts finished cuts. The assistant is read-only and preserves the current CUT. Frosted facets show “Frosted facet · Do not polish”; this reminder does not add cuts.
